A [[human]] '''individual''' dark skin and [[color|black]] [[hair]] that was present in lounge at [[Gate 9]] of the [[Imperial Senate Building]] in [[2 BBY]] when [[Senior Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] delivered a speech denouncing the [[Ghorman Massacre]] which they viewed on a [[viewscreen]]. After the speech they were still in the lounge at Gate 9 when Mothma and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] exited the [[turbolift]] from the senate chamber to a crowd of [[journalist]]s. As Mothma made her way through the crowd, a human named [[Beska]] drew and aimed their [[blaster]] on Mothma claiming to be making an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] authorized arrest. [[Erskin Semaj]], Mothma's aid, provided a distraction by call Beska a rebel spy which gave Andor the chance to draw [[Clem's blaster pistol|his blaster]] and shoot Beska. After picking up Beska's blaster, Semaj used it to cover  [[Escape from the Senate|Mothma and Andor's escape]] before he too leaves the senate building. During the incident, the bystander wore an orange [[jacket]] over a red [[clothing|top]] and orange pants.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The individual appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" /> which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Gemma Knight Jones]] in the episode and credited as simply "Lounge #1".<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion" />
